name: Splat-to-Voxel Transfer
definition: A procedure to convert point-based Gaussian primitives into a structured voxel representation by depositing splat attributes onto a dense high-resolution voxel grid.
summary: Splat-to-Voxel Transfer converts unstructured 3D Gaussians into a structured voxel grid using a coarse-to-fine hierarchy and sparsification to reduce computational load for transformer networks.
